title: Add single-token step API to Llama/Mistral/Phi/Qwen/Gemma models
Fix E0608 errors: IxDyn array indexing type coercion
description: All 74+ errors are E0608 "cannot index into a value of type `[T; N]`". Root cause: ndarray::IxDyn expects &[isize], but array literals like [1][..] infer as [i32;1] and [a,b,c][..] with usize values infer as [usize;N]. Fix: convert all IxDyn(&[...][..]) to use vec![...as isize].as_slice() pattern.
